_comment: Per-album genre tabs, for when the automatic mapping gets it wrong.
Keyed by slug. The list replaces the auto-detected tabs entirely, and the
first entry is the primary genre - the one a review page's genre link
points to. parse_reviews.py reads this file and never writes to it, so
edits here survive re-running the parser.
Valid tabs: Rock, Alternative, Hip-hop, Electronic, Pop, R&B, Jazz,
